Ikkaku external mandatory stay includes self, ignored recipients, actual opponent destroy/bounce/mana spells, opponent S-Trigger on own turn and simultaneous opposing sweep, excludes own spells, creature effects and zero-power state destruction. Real Akashic Parallel copies from opponent, original returns through actual Corile, then clone alone retains new abilities. Encrypted duel service covers all three abilities and each side with physical conservation and persisted choices. Shared old required-blocker/blocked-trigger/ultimate-evolution/spell-stay/win-watch regressions passed; no full npm test or known long group run.
